description.zh: 企业版实例的实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。
description.en: The instance ID of the Enterprise instance. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

description.zh: License类型（音视频规格），可取值：**480P**、**720P**。
description.en: The license type (audio and video specification). Valid values: **480P**, **720P**.

description.zh:
待授权的产品的ProductKey。

您可以在物联网平台控制台或调用接口[QueryProductList](~~69271~~)，查看当前实例下所有产品的信息。
description.en:
The ProductKey of the product to be authorized.

You can view the information of all products under the current instance in the IoT Platform console or by calling the [QueryProductList](~~69271~~) API.

title.en: Authorize a License for a Specified Product

descriptions.zh:
## 使用说明
调用本接口前，请购买License。具体内容，请参见[购买方式](~~427935~~)。


## QPS限制

单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为10。

> RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## How-To

Before invoking this API, purchase a license. For more information, see [Purchase Method](~~427935~~).


## QPS Limit

The maximum queries per second (QPS) for a single Alibaba Cloud account calling this API is 10.

> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot bind-license-product --iot-instance-id iot-23000 --license-code 480P --product-key a1BwAGV000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
